mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.25% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month indicates a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer spending and business confidence increase.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over two months signals a strengthening demand for housing, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the broader economy benefits from increased construction activity.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where HOUST increased by more than 5% over two months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a weakening supply side, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic output slows and corporate earnings are negatively impacted.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of the instances where INDPRO decreased by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on mechanism where low levels of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1%) are associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to the stimulative effect of cheap borrowing costs on the economy.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative more than 50% of the time when FEDFUNDS is below 1%.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven mechanism where a simultaneous increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases & UNRATE decreases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where both RSAFS increased and UNRATE decreased by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A regime-conditional mechanism where a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3% in a month during a period of low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2%) signals a healthy labor market without overheating, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.3% in a month and CPIAUCSL was below 2%.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven mechanism where a simultaneous increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals a robust economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO increases & UNRATE decreases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where both INDPRO increased and UNRATE decreased by more than 0.5% in a month.
